featured_reviews.review_text:
We had our destination wedding in Udaipur, India, and the overall experience with the team was a mix of highs and lows. Siddharth, Jance, Chinmai and Nandini did an amazing job ensuring our big day was beautifully executed. They were professional, attentive, and went above and beyond to accommodate our needs. Their dedication truly made a difference, and we are grateful for their hard work. The team also helped us with shadows on the day of the event which was very helpful.

However, the owner was disappointing to work with, mainly due to a lack of transparency and support when dealing with vendors. They did not assist in negotiating with key vendors, especially the venue, which was one of the most expensive aspect of our wedding. We expected better advocacy on our behalf, but unfortunately that did not happen.

Additionally, the team could greatly benefit from improved IT solutions to streamline planning, communication, and logistics. A more structured approach would enhance their efficiency.

Having said this, we would like to thank the whole team for making our day extra special. Thank you!

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text: Our wedding was so flawless because we had the best team of Mayur and Yash by our side. As newlyweds, my spouse and I cannot express enough gratitude and appreciation to Panaash Entertainment for making our dream wedding a reality. From the moment we engaged their services until the last dance of the night, Panaash demonstrated unparalleled professionalism, creativity, and attention to detail.  Right from our initial meeting, their team exuded warmth and enthusiasm. They took the time to understand our vision and expectations, and their suggestions and ideas were invaluable in enhancing the overall experience. Throughout the planning process, they were prompt and responsive to our questions, providing us with a sense of reassurance that everything was being handled with care.  Panaash Entertainment's organizational skills were truly commendable. They coordinated with vendors seamlessly, ensuring that every aspect of the event was executed flawlessly. From the stunning floral arrangements to the exquisite decor and lighting, our venue was transformed into a magical wonderland that left all our guests in awe.  One aspect that stood out was their ability to cater to both traditional and contemporary preferences. Our families come from diverse cultural backgrounds, and Panaash managed to strike the perfect balance, infusing elements from both our cultures to create a harmonious celebration that appealed to everyone.  On the day of the wedding, their team worked tirelessly behind the scenes, ensuring that everything unfolded smoothly. We were able to relax and enjoy the festivities, knowing that Panaash was taking care of every detail. They even managed unexpected challenges with grace and quick thinking, which further solidified our trust in their capabilities.  Not only did Panaash Entertainment excel in their planning skills, but their personable and attentive approach made them a joy to work with. They treated us like family and shared in our excitement, which created a genuine and heartfelt connection.  In conclusion, we wholeheartedly recommend Panaash Entertainment to anyone seeking a wedding planner who goes above and beyond to create a magical and unforgettable experience. Their expertise, creativity, and dedication truly set them apart, and we couldn't have asked for a more perfect wedding day. Thank you, Panaash, for making our dreams come true!

Yash and Mayur was fantastic, corporative and made all the arrangements of wedding easy. After reaching Mumbai for wedding I met whole Panaash Entertainment team and everyone was fantastic and awesome and made this wedding successful. Being bride brother, had so many responsibilities - Handling Hotel arrangements, attending relatives, coordinating with everyone etc but these guys made my life easy and was able to enjoy the wedding to the fullest.
We had 3 functions in 1 day, and have to decorate the same room 3 times. These guys made it possible and that too on time.

Thank you again for making this marriage a grand success.😍😘😃

Managing this entire thing between 2 cities and a pandemic, Yash and Mayur made sure that these 2 days became the most memorable 2 days because we didn’t have to worry about anything but our expressions in the photos!!!!

Yash with his trademark, ‘haan ho jaega’ and Mayur with his, ‘aare aap tension kyu le rahe ho, hum dekh lenge’, deliver what they promise - if you know me, you know it will be done.

Thanks a lot Yash, Mayur and the entire team at Panaash! You guys rock :)
